about: Robert N. Katz attended law school and graduated from University of Georgia School of Law in 1987. Robert Katz began practicing law in 1987.
Robert Katz is an attorney at Katz & Fleming, LLC, helping people with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Katz & Fleming, LLC has an office in Decatur, Georgia, serving the local community.

Robert Katz was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
